Package com.hiface.sdk.common

Enum HiFaceErrorCode

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<HiFaceErrorCode>
com.hiface.sdk.common.HiFaceErrorCode
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<HiFaceErrorCode>
public enum HiFaceErrorCode extends java.lang.Enum<HiFaceErrorCode>
Stable processing error codes. Liveness and dynamic verification pass/reject/timeout outcomes use FaceFlowOutcome. Error text may change; use codes for application decisions. New codes are appended without changing existing meanings.

    • NOT_FOUND

      public static final HiFaceErrorCode NOT_FOUND

    • DATABASE_ERROR

      public static final HiFaceErrorCode DATABASE_ERROR

    • RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED

      public static final HiFaceErrorCode RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED

    • ALREADY_EXISTS

      public static final HiFaceErrorCode ALREADY_EXISTS
      Face ID conflict. saveFeature and saveFeatures currently replace entries with the same ID; the application handles confirmation before replacement.

    • LICENSE_MISSING

      public static final HiFaceErrorCode LICENSE_MISSING
      The platform is configured, but offline authorization has not been imported successfully. Import a vendor-signed certificate.

    • LICENSE_INVALID

      public static final HiFaceErrorCode LICENSE_INVALID
      Invalid authorization content/signature, binding mismatch, incompatible protocol/SDK, or invalid persisted state. Verify the cause and use an approved replacement or recovery; do not clear state to bypass validation.

    • LICENSE_NOT_YET_VALID

      public static final HiFaceErrorCode LICENSE_NOT_YET_VALID
      Authorization is not yet effective. Keep system time correct and import again after its start time; the current valid authorization is not replaced.

    • LICENSE_EXPIRED

      public static final HiFaceErrorCode LICENSE_EXPIRED
      Overall authorization expired or expiry is latched. Renewal requires a vendor-signed higher revision. Rolling the clock back does not restore validity.

    • LICENSE_FEATURE_DENIED

      public static final HiFaceErrorCode LICENSE_FEATURE_DENIED
      Overall authorization is valid, but this capability or a required capability is not granted or has expired separately. A valid authorization including that capability is required.

    • LICENSE_CLOCK_INVALID

      public static final HiFaceErrorCode LICENSE_CLOCK_INVALID
      Clock rollback or a clock error. If the corrected time reaches the last trusted time and the certificate is still valid, recreate the advanced session to resume. Earlier times require a manufacturer-signed recovery.
